title: First General Meeting
caption: An opportunity to bring students together around data analytics, technical learning, and community.

heading: Student Leadership
body: As a Resident Advisor, I was responsible for 96 students across apartments and houses, planning events and building a community they actually wanted to be part of. As Multi Cultural Programing Board Co-Chair, I helped organize campus events with real cultural significance. As Marketing Chair for Student Government, I ran the social media accounts that gave campus life its voice.

title: ASA Best Data Insight Winners
caption: Led students to Chicago to compete in ASA DataFest, where our team won the Best Insight award.

heading: Building a Club from Zero
body: I founded and run the Data Analytics Club from scratch: workshops, speaker events, and member projects in data science and analytics, with a speaker series, student mentorship, and hackathons I led myself.

title: Augustana's First Datathon
caption: Organized the first datathon event at Augustana College.

title: MPA Poster Presentation
caption: Presented a directed forgetting research project.
